method: All seven PNGs opened with view_image and visually inspected; unfiltered progressive rendering, no image editing.
findings: Day/night Cloud Gate heroes retain smoothly curved skyline and plaza reflections, a readable underside and paving detail.
Art Institute entrance, stairs, paired lions and modeled historic facade are visible in day/night.
Willis departure framing retains the tower and shared Chicago context.
The four-minute route endpoint is inside a lit interpreted gallery with readable artwork and floor/wall details.
limitations: Procedural authored geometry rather than surveyed/photogrammetric reproduction.
Fine grain remains in unfiltered stills, particularly indirect interior and night reflections.
This still review does not certify motion noise performance.
